notes: דְּבַר־כָּזָב → *lies* is one indivisible unit: the ASV writes a single word for the pair, so rule 30's condition is met and neither morpheme can be left unrepresented; head on כָּזָב, which carries the lexeme.
*neither … nor* divides under rule 14: the present prohibitive אַל is itself what *neither* says and takes the opening correlative, so the waw takes only the closing connective.
*Remove far* heads on *far*, the adjectival complement carrying the רחק lexeme (rule 44); heading on *Remove* is the competing reading and is recorded in the unit note.
